summary_en: SMFG authorized acquisition of up to 85 million shares for a maximum of 220 billion yen (1.1% of outstanding shares) through market purchases from November 16, 2026 to February 28, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on March 19, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares and Determination of Matters Concerning Cancellation of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 13, 2026, Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMFG) announced authorization to acquire its own shares to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. The company will purchase up to 85 million shares with a maximum expenditure of 220 billion yen, representing 1.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. Purchases will be executed through market acquisitions under a discretionary trading agreement during the period from November 16, 2026 through February 28, 2027. As of October 31, 2026, SMFG had issued 7,582,003,610 shares excluding treasury stock. All shares acquired under this authorization will be cancelled effective March 19, 2027, as mandated by the Companies Act. The specific number of shares to be cancelled will be announced after the acquisition is completed.
